title: Taking Turns
logline: Kelliee's turn on the swing gets taken, and she wants to shout — until TyGuy shows her what God's Word says about kindness and forgiveness, and the playground becomes peaceful again.
bible_verse: Ephesians 4:32 — "Be kind to one another, tender-hearted, forgiving one another, as God in Christ forgave you."
life_lesson: When someone is unfair to us, Jesus helps us choose kindness and forgiveness instead of anger.
call_to_jesus: Jesus forgives us, so we can forgive others. Ask Him into your heart and let Him help you be kind every day.

characters.name: Ben
characters.appearance: a 3D cartoon boy, age 9, short sandy-blond hair, light skin, round cheeks
characters.wardrobe: green-striped t-shirt, grey shorts, red sneakers
characters.voice: energetic young boy, a little impatient at first
characters.personality: excitable, doesn't realize he cut in line, quick to say sorry
characters.consistent: sandy-blond hair and green-striped shirt in every shot he appears in

voiceover.tone: warm, gentle picture-book storyteller for young children
lines: God's Word gives us a special rule for our hearts...
But being kind is hard when something feels unfair.
When we're hurt, our first feeling can be anger.
Jesus shows us a better way — to forgive.
And when we forgive, peace comes back.
Will you follow Jesus and let Him make your heart kind?

scenes.location: a sunny cartoon neighborhood park with a swing set, green grass, and a big leafy tree
scenes.action: TyGuy waves warmly to camera while Kelliee bounces beside him holding an open kids' Bible; he gestures to the page
scenes.camera: medium two-shot, slow gentle push-in, eye level
scenes.lighting: bright warm morning sunlight, soft golden glow
dialogue: TyGuy: Hey friends! Today's verse is Ephesians four, thirty-two.
Kelliee: "Be kind to one another, and forgive one another!"
scenes.ending_frame: Kelliee proudly holds the Bible up toward camera, then looks off toward the swings — camera ready to follow her

scenes.location: the same sunny park, standing on the grass near the swing set
scenes.action: TyGuy kneels to Kelliee's level and points to his heart, then to the swings; Kelliee nods, eager to play
dialogue: TyGuy: That means: be kind, and forgive — even when it's hard.
Kelliee: Got it! Now can I swing?
scenes.ending_frame: Kelliee skips toward an empty swing, the swing clearly open and waiting in frame

scenes.location: right at the swing set on the grass
scenes.action: just as Kelliee reaches for the empty swing, Ben dashes in and hops onto it first, not noticing her
scenes.camera: medium shot, quick gentle whip toward the swing, eye level
scenes.consistent: Kelliee's reaching hand and surprised face stay clearly readable
scenes.ending_frame: Kelliee freezes mid-reach, swing now taken, her smile dropping into a shocked frown — hold on her face

scenes.location: beside the swing set on the grass
scenes.action: Kelliee crosses her arms, scrunches her face, stomps one foot, and opens her mouth as if to shout
scenes.camera: medium close-up, slight low angle, holds steady on her
scenes.lighting: warm sun, a touch cooler to feel her frustration
scenes.mood: frustrated, upset (gentle and kid-appropriate, never scary)
dialogue: Kelliee: Hey! That was MY turn! That's not fair!
scenes.avoid: yelling face that looks frightening, tears, anything harsh or mean
scenes.ending_frame: Kelliee, arms crossed and pouting, as a familiar blue sleeve enters frame — TyGuy's hand resting gently on her shoulder

scenes.location: kneeling together on the grass beside the swings
scenes.action: TyGuy kneels beside Kelliee, hand on her shoulder, gently opens the Bible; Kelliee's angry face slowly softens as she listens
scenes.camera: intimate two-shot, slow push-in, eye level
scenes.lighting: soft warm sunbeam breaking through, a touch of heavenly glow
dialogue: TyGuy: Remember our verse? Be kind, and forgive.
TyGuy: Jesus forgave us — we can forgive Ben too.
scenes.ending_frame: Kelliee uncrosses her arms and takes a calming breath, a small forgiving smile returning; she turns toward Ben

scenes.location: at the swing set on the grass
scenes.action: Kelliee walks up kindly; Ben realizes and hops off, apologizing; they smile and Ben offers her the swing, then they take turns happily
scenes.camera: medium two-shot, warm slow push-in, eye level
scenes.lighting: full bright golden morning sun, warm and glowing
dialogue: Ben: Oh — sorry! I didn't see you. You go first!
Kelliee: Thanks, Ben! Let's take turns.
scenes.consistent: Ben same sandy-blond hair and green-striped shirt; both genuinely happy
scenes.ending_frame: Kelliee swings gently with Ben pushing, both laughing; TyGuy steps into frame from the side, smiling at camera

scenes.location: in front of the swing set, warm sunny park behind them
scenes.action: TyGuy and Kelliee stand together facing camera; TyGuy places a hand on his heart, Kelliee gives a thumbs-up
scenes.camera: medium two-shot, gentle slow push-in, eye level
scenes.lighting: warm golden light with soft heavenly glow and floating gold sparkles
dialogue: TyGuy: Jesus forgives us, so we can forgive others.
TyGuy: Ask Jesus into your heart, and let Him make you kind!
Kelliee: Be kind, forgive, and follow Jesus! See you next time!
scenes.ending_frame: freeze on TyGuy and Kelliee waving together, golden sparkles and a soft glowing cross, brand-blue tones, clean space at top for an end card
